card.name: Olho de Águia
card.summary: Quando este monstro é Invocado por Invocação-Normal, nenhum jogador pode ativar Armadilhas em resposta a essa Invocação.

textEvidence.text: When this monster itself is successfully Normal Summoned, neither player can activate Trap Cards in the immediate response window to that Normal Summon. The prohibition does not apply to Flip Summons, Special Summons, other monsters being summoned, or later chain windows. It has no activation, cost, target, secondary operation or duration beyond the specified summoning window. Monster-effect negation stops this restriction while the source is face-up.
